name: Chicken Pasta Salad with Apple, Pecans, Greens & Orange-Dijon Dressing

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g penne pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ oranges
2 Granny Smith apples
1 ½ (142 g) pkg spring mix (mixed greens)

instructions.primary_message: Juice oranges into a large bowl.
Add oil, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the orange juice; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp white wine vinegar
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add chicken to the skillet and pan-fry until cooked through and golden brown, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove from heat and set aside.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, peel, halve, and thinly slice shallots into half-moons; add to the bowl with the dressing.
Quarter, core, and thinly slice apples; add to the bowl.
Coarsely chop pecans and add to the bowl.
When the pasta is done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool; add to the bowl along with the mixed greens. Toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide the salad between plates or bowls and top with sliced chicken. Enjoy!
